"""Two-speed surface fitting over existing native CAD parameters. No network I/O."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.interpolate import RectBivariateSpline
from .cad_parameters import CADParameterRegistry
from .geometry_acceleration import SurfaceIndex, deviation_statistics
from .geometry_cache import GeometryCache, ResourceBudget
from .mesh_analyzer import analyze_mesh
from .mesh_sampling import STAGES, sample_surface
from .mesh_to_cad import build_native, tessellate_build
from .mesh_cad_schema import DenseOptimizationOptions
from .photo_schema import PhotoDesign, number


@dataclass
class DenseOptimizationResult:
    plan: PhotoDesign
    build: object
    report: dict
    reference: object
    deviation_points: np.ndarray
    deviation_mm: np.ndarray


class FitBudgetStop(Exception):
    pass


def resolved_frame(part, values):
    rotation = Rotation.from_euler('xyz', [number(v, values) for v in part.rotation_deg], degrees=True).as_matrix()
    center = np.array([number(v, values) for v in part.position])
    size = np.array([number(v, values) for v in part.size])
    return rotation, center, size


class ComponentProxy:
    """Cached local samples; affine primitives and section/path displacements.

    These are trial approximations. Only rebuilt, checked B-Reps may be accepted.
    """
    def __init__(self, plan, samples):
        self.plan, self.samples = plan, samples
        self.values = {v.key: v.value for v in plan.values}
        self.local = {}
        for index, part in enumerate(plan.parts):
            selected = samples.component_ids == index
            rotation, center, size = resolved_frame(part, self.values)
            local = (samples.points[selected] - center) @ rotation
            normals = samples.normals[selected] @ rotation
            self.local[index] = selected, local, normals, size

    def evaluate(self, plan):
        values = {v.key: v.value for v in plan.values}
        points = np.empty_like(self.samples.points, dtype=float)
        normals = np.empty_like(points)
        for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(self.plan.parts, plan.parts)):
            selected, local, local_normals, size = self.local[index]
            rotation, center, new_size = resolved_frame(after, values)
            ratio = new_size / size
            moved = local * ratio
            if before.path and len(before.path) == len(after.path):
                original = np.array([[number(v, self.values) for v in p] for p in before.path])
                changed = np.array([[number(v, values) for v in p] for p in after.path])
                # Local radial interpolation of sparse meaningful path controls.
                _, nearest = cKDTree(original).query(local)
                moved += changed[nearest] - original[nearest]
            if before.sections and len(before.sections) == len(after.sections):
                original = np.array([[number(v, self.values) for v in p.center] for p in before.sections])
                changed = np.array([[number(v, values) for v in p.center] for p in after.sections])
                _, nearest = cKDTree(original).query(local)
                moved += changed[nearest] - original[nearest]
                widths_before = np.array([number(p.width, self.values) for p in before.sections])
                widths_after = np.array([number(p.width, values) for p in after.sections])
                depths_before = np.array([number(p.depth, self.values) for p in before.sections])
                depths_after = np.array([number(p.depth, values) for p in after.sections])
                moved[:, 0] *= (widths_after/widths_before)[nearest]
                moved[:, 1] *= (depths_after/depths_before)[nearest]
            if before.outline and len(before.outline) == len(after.outline):
                original = np.array([[number(v, self.values) for v in p] for p in before.outline])
                changed = np.array([[number(v, values) for v in p] for p in after.outline])
                _, nearest = cKDTree(original).query(local[:, :2])
                moved[:, :2] += changed[nearest]-original[nearest]
            if before.surface_grid and after.surface_grid:
                original = np.array([[number(v, self.values) for v in row] for row in before.surface_grid.depths])
                changed = np.array([[number(v, values) for v in row] for row in after.surface_grid.depths])
                ny, nx = original.shape
                spline = RectBivariateSpline(np.linspace(-size[1]/2, size[1]/2, ny),
                    np.linspace(-size[0]/2, size[0]/2, nx), changed-original, kx=min(3, ny-1), ky=min(3, nx-1))
                # Blend the dish displacement down through the stock thickness;
                # the lower panel remains anchored in this trial approximation.
                blend = np.clip((local[:, 2]+size[2]/2)/size[2], 0, 1)
                moved[:, 2] -= spline.ev(local[:, 1], local[:, 0])*blend
            points[selected] = moved @ rotation.T + center
            normal = (local_normals / ratio) @ rotation.T
            normals[selected] = normal / np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(normal, axis=1)[:, None], 1e-12)
        return points, normals


def assign_reference_components(reference, cad, threads=4):
    closest = SurfaceIndex(cad, threads=threads).closest(reference.mesh.triangles_center)
    labels = cad.face_components[closest['face_ids']]
    result = analyze_mesh(reference.mesh, labels)
    return result


def sensitive_parameters(registry, plan, cad_samples, maximum):
    """Bounded mathematical probes avoid spending solves on inert controls."""
    from dataclasses import replace
    ids = np.linspace(0, len(cad_samples.points)-1, min(512, len(cad_samples.points)), dtype=int)
    subset = replace(cad_samples, **{name: getattr(cad_samples, name)[ids] for name in
        ('points', 'normals', 'face_ids', 'component_ids', 'area_weights')})
    proxy = ComponentProxy(plan, subset)
    initial, _ = proxy.evaluate(plan)
    measured = []
    phases = ('global', 'position', 'component', 'curve')
    candidates = registry.candidates()
    probe_candidates = [p for phase in phases for p in [item for item in candidates if item.phase == phase][:24]]
    for parameter in probe_candidates:
        value = min(parameter.maximum, parameter.current_value+max(.01, (parameter.maximum-parameter.minimum)*.03))
        if value == parameter.current_value:
            value = max(parameter.minimum, parameter.current_value-.01)
        try:
            changed = registry.apply({parameter.parameter_id: value})
            points, _ = proxy.evaluate(changed)
            sensitivity = float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum((points-initial)**2, axis=1)))/max(abs(value-parameter.current_value), 1e-9))
            if sensitivity > 1e-6:
                measured.append((parameter, sensitivity))
        except ValueError:
            continue
    phase = {'global':0, 'position':1, 'component':2, 'curve':3}
    measured.sort(key=lambda item: (phase[item[0].phase], -item[1]))
    pools = {name: [p for p, _ in measured if p.phase == name] for name in phases}
    selected = []
    while len(selected) < maximum and any(pools.values()):
        for name in phases:
            if pools[name] and len(selected) < maximum:
                selected.append(pools[name].pop(0))
    return selected, {p.parameter_id: sensitivity for p, sensitivity in measured}


def bidirectional_report(reference_index, cad, reference_samples, count, budget, cache, component_aware):
    cad_samples = sample_surface(cad, count, budget=budget, cache=cache)
    cad_index = SurfaceIndex(cad, threads=budget.workers)
    forward = reference_index.closest(cad_samples.points, cad_samples.component_ids if component_aware else None)
    reverse = cad_index.closest(reference_samples.points, reference_samples.component_ids if component_aware else None)
    a, b = forward['distances'], reverse['distances']
    normal_error = 1 - np.clip(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', cad_samples.normals, forward['normals']), -1, 1)
    per_component = {}
    for component in np.unique(reference_samples.component_ids):
        selected = reference_samples.component_ids == component
        per_component[str(int(component))] = deviation_statistics(b[selected], reference_samples.area_weights[selected])
    report = dict(cad_to_reference=deviation_statistics(a, cad_samples.area_weights),
        reference_to_cad=deviation_statistics(b, reference_samples.area_weights), components=per_component,
        symmetric_mean_mm=float((np.sum(a*cad_samples.area_weights)+np.sum(b*reference_samples.area_weights))*.5),
        normal_loss=float(np.sum(normal_error*cad_samples.area_weights)),
        distance_method='Open3D closest triangle surface on temporary CAD tessellation',
        cad_tessellation_tolerance_mm=.25, reference_points=len(b), cad_points=len(a))
    return report, reverse


def photo_error(plan, build, views):
    """Reviewed image evidence uses the existing native projection engine."""
    from .cad_projection import NativeProjection, project_points, landmark_point, curve_points
    from .cad_optimizer import boundary_distances
    errors = []
    evidence = []
    for view in views:
        if view.camera is None or not view.camera.reliable:
            evidence.append(dict(image_id=str(view.image_id), status='unverified', reason='A reliable photo camera is required'))
            continue
        diagonal = np.hypot(*view.camera.image_size)
        local = []
        for landmark in view.landmarks:
            if landmark.visible:
                projected = project_points([landmark_point(landmark, plan, build)], view.camera)[0]
                local.append(float(np.linalg.norm(projected-landmark.image_point)/diagonal)*landmark.confidence)
        for curve in view.curves:
            if curve.visible:
                projected = project_points(curve_points(curve, plan, build), view.camera)
                local.extend((boundary_distances(projected, curve.image_points)/diagonal*curve.confidence).tolist())
        if view.silhouette and view.silhouette_reviewed:
            # The established projection API supplies exact B-Rep HLR contours.
            projection = NativeProjection(build, view.camera)
            predicted = projection.silhouette()
            local.extend((boundary_distances(predicted, view.silhouette)/diagonal).tolist())
        if local:
            errors.extend(local)
            evidence.append(dict(image_id=str(view.image_id), status='measured', error=float(np.mean(local))))
    return (float(np.mean(errors)) if errors else None), evidence


def optimize_dense_cad(plan, reference, options=None, *, inputs=None, cache=None, progress=None, photo_bytes=None, publish_best=None):
    from .engineering_cad import geometry_checks, check_supplied_dimensions
    options = DenseOptimizationOptions.model_validate(options or {})
    plan = PhotoDesign.model_validate(plan)
    inputs = inputs or {}
    cache = cache or GeometryCache()
    budget = ResourceBudget(options.memory_mb, workers=options.workers)
    started = time.monotonic()
    deadline = started + options.max_seconds
    evaluations = 0
    controls = options.controls.model_copy(update={'mode': 'quality' if options.mode == 'extended' else options.mode})
    registry = CADParameterRegistry(plan, inputs.get('known_values', []), controls)
    active = registry.candidates()[:options.max_parameters] if options.enabled else []
    baseline = build_native(plan, inputs)
    baseline_checks = geometry_checks(baseline)
    photo_reference = None
    if photo_bytes:
        from .mesh_photo_verification import PhotoReference
        photo_reference = PhotoReference(photo_bytes, plan, baseline, options.photo_reference)
    required = {tuple(sorted((c['a'], c['b']))) for c in baseline_checks['contacts']}
    required.update(tuple(sorted(c)) for c in controls.required_contacts)
    cad = tessellate_build(baseline)
    reference = assign_reference_components(reference, cad, budget.workers) if options.component_aware else reference
    # Missing component coverage is explicit; no cross-component nearest matches.
    available = set(np.unique(reference.face_components))
    if options.component_aware and not set(range(len(plan.parts))) <= available:
        raise ValueError('Reference lacks correspondences for one or more native CAD components')
    reference_index = SurfaceIndex(reference, threads=budget.workers)
    target_count, view_count = STAGES[options.mode]
    stages = [25_000] + ([100_000] if target_count >= 100_000 else []) + ([300_000] if target_count >= 300_000 else [])
    # Extended mode increases verification density, not rebuilds per trial.
    cameras, reference_views = [], []
    if options.multi_angle:
        from .multiview_geometry import generate_cameras
        from .adaptive_view_selector import select_views
        candidates = generate_cameras(reference.mesh.bounds, view_count, resolution=options.camera_resolution)
        cameras, reference_views = select_views(reference_index, candidates)
    def exact_metrics(build, model, count):
        points = sample_surface(reference, count, budget=budget, cache=cache, adaptive=options.adaptive_sampling)
        model_cad = tessellate_build(build)
        measurements, reverse = bidirectional_report(reference_index, model_cad, points, count, budget, cache, options.component_aware)
        photo, evidence = photo_error(model, build, options.photo_views)
        if photo is None and photo_reference is not None:
            photo, automatic_evidence = photo_reference.evaluate(model, build)
            evidence.append(automatic_evidence)
        view_loss = 0.
        if cameras:
            from .multiview_geometry import multiview_report
            view_report = multiview_report(reference_index, SurfaceIndex(model_cad, threads=budget.workers), cameras, reference_views)
            view_loss = view_report['silhouette_iou_loss']
        scale = max(np.linalg.norm(np.ptp(reference.mesh.bounds, axis=0)), 1.)
        score = options.surface_weight*measurements['symmetric_mean_mm']/scale + options.normal_weight*measurements['normal_loss']
        score += options.silhouette_weight*view_loss
        if photo is not None:
            score += options.photo_weight*photo
        return score, measurements, model_cad, photo, evidence, reverse
    best_score, initial, best_cad, best_photo, photo_evidence, _ = exact_metrics(baseline, plan, 25_000)
    initial_score = best_score
    best_plan, best_build, best_checks = plan, baseline, baseline_checks
    if publish_best:
        publish_best(best_plan, best_build)
    revisions, attempts, stage_reports = [], [], []
    stop_reason = 'completed'
    for count in stages:
        if not active or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            stop_reason = 'disabled_or_no_active_parameters' if not active else 'wall_time_budget'
            break
        stage_started = time.monotonic()
        registry = CADParameterRegistry(best_plan, inputs.get('known_values', []), controls)
        importance = None
        if options.adaptive_sampling and count > 25_000:
            current_index = SurfaceIndex(best_cad, threads=budget.workers)
            face_error = current_index.closest(reference.mesh.triangles_center)['distances']
            importance = face_error/max(float(np.quantile(face_error, .9)), .01)
        reference_samples = sample_surface(reference, count, budget=budget, cache=cache,
            adaptive=options.adaptive_sampling, importance=importance)
        cad_samples = sample_surface(best_cad, count, budget=budget, cache=cache)
        active, sensitivities = sensitive_parameters(registry, best_plan, cad_samples, options.max_parameters)
        if not active:
            stop_reason = 'no_sensitive_unlocked_parameters'
            break
        proxy = ComponentProxy(best_plan, cad_samples)
        shortlisted = []
        start_score = best_score
        start_evaluations = evaluations
        updates = {}
        for phase in ('global', 'position', 'component', 'curve'):
            group = [p for p in active if p.phase == phase]
            if not group:
                continue
            x0 = np.array([p.current_value for p in group])
            low, high = np.array([p.minimum for p in group]), np.array([p.maximum for p in group])
            group = [p for p in group if p.maximum-p.minimum > 1e-8]
            if not group:
                continue
            x0 = np.array([updates.get(p.parameter_id, p.current_value) for p in group])
            low = np.array([p.minimum for p in group]); high = np.array([p.maximum for p in group])
            size = len(cad_samples.points) + len(reference_samples.points) + len(cad_samples.points) + len(group)
            diagonal = max(np.linalg.norm(np.ptp(reference.mesh.bounds, axis=0)), 1.)
            best_proxy = [np.inf, evaluations]
            def residual(x):
                nonlocal evaluations
                if evaluations >= options.max_evaluations or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    raise FitBudgetStop()
                if evaluations-best_proxy[1] >= controls.stagnation_evaluations:
                    raise FitBudgetStop()
                evaluations += 1
                trial = {**updates, **dict(zip((p.parameter_id for p in group), x))}
                try:
                    candidate = registry.apply(trial)
                    points, normals = proxy.evaluate(candidate)
                    match = reference_index.closest(points, cad_samples.component_ids if options.component_aware else None)
                    # The reverse fast term uses a point-cloud approximation.
                    reverse = np.empty(len(reference_samples.points))
                    labels = np.unique(reference_samples.component_ids) if options.component_aware else [None]
                    for label in labels:
                        a = cad_samples.component_ids == label if label is not None else np.ones(len(points), dtype=bool)
                        b = reference_samples.component_ids == label if label is not None else np.ones(len(reverse), dtype=bool)
                        reverse[b] = cKDTree(points[a]).query(reference_samples.points[b], workers=budget.workers)[0]
                    normal = 1-np.clip(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', normals, match['normals']), -1, 1)
                    result = np.concatenate((match['distances']/diagonal*np.sqrt(cad_samples.area_weights*options.surface_weight),
                        reverse/diagonal*np.sqrt(reference_samples.area_weights*options.surface_weight),
                        normal*np.sqrt(cad_samples.area_weights*options.normal_weight),
                        (x-x0)/np.maximum(high-low, 1)*np.sqrt(options.regularization_weight)))
                    loss = float(result@result)
                    if loss < best_proxy[0]-1e-12:
                        best_proxy[:] = [loss, evaluations]
                    shortlisted.append((loss, trial))
                    shortlisted.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
                    del shortlisted[options.exact_candidates*3:]
                except (ValueError, FloatingPointError):
                    result = np.full(size, 10.)
                if progress:
                    progress('fitting', evaluations, options.max_evaluations)
                return result
            try:
                result = least_squares(residual, x0, bounds=(low, high), loss='soft_l1',
                    diff_step=.01, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=max(1, (options.max_evaluations-evaluations)//(len(group)+1)),
                    ftol=1e-5, xtol=1e-4, gtol=1e-6)
                updates.update(dict(zip((p.parameter_id for p in group), result.x)))
            except FitBudgetStop:
                stop_reason = 'evaluation_or_wall_time_budget'
                break
        seen = set()
        for _, trial in shortlisted:
            key = tuple(sorted(trial.items()))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            if len(seen) > options.exact_candidates or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                break
            try:
                candidate = registry.apply(trial)
                build = build_native(candidate, inputs)
                checks = geometry_checks(build)
                contacts = {tuple(sorted((c['a'], c['b']))) for c in checks['contacts']}
                if not required <= contacts:
                    raise ValueError('Candidate lost a required assembly contact')
                score, metrics, model_cad, photo, evidence, _ = exact_metrics(build, candidate, 25_000)
                # Reviewed photo evidence vetoes a worsening candidate, even if
                # the estimated reference mesh prefers that candidate.
                if best_photo is not None and (photo is None or photo > best_photo+1e-6):
                    raise ValueError('Candidate worsens reviewed original-photo evidence')
                attempts.append(dict(valid=True, score=score, updates=trial))
                if score < best_score-options.minimum_improvement:
                    best_plan, best_build, best_checks, best_cad = candidate, build, checks, model_cad
                    best_score, best_photo, photo_evidence = score, photo, evidence
                    revisions.append(dict(score=score, surface_mean_mm=metrics['symmetric_mean_mm'], updates=trial))
                    if publish_best:
                        publish_best(best_plan, best_build)
            except Exception as exc:
                attempts.append(dict(valid=False, reason=str(exc)[:300], updates=trial))
        stage_reports.append(dict(requested_points=count, actual_points=len(reference_samples.points),
            evaluations=evaluations-start_evaluations, seconds=time.monotonic()-stage_started,
            exact_score_improvement=start_score-best_score, sensitivities=sensitivities))
        if start_score-best_score < options.minimum_improvement:
            stop_reason = 'density_increase_did_not_improve_fit'
            break
    verification_count = options.verify_points
    final_reference = sample_surface(reference, verification_count, budget=budget, cache=cache, adaptive=options.adaptive_sampling)
    final_cad = tessellate_build(best_build)
    final, reverse = bidirectional_report(reference_index, final_cad, final_reference,
                                          verification_count, budget, cache, options.component_aware)
    locked = check_supplied_dimensions(best_build, inputs.get('known_values', []))
    multiview = None
    if options.multi_angle:
        from .multiview_geometry import generate_cameras, multiview_report
        final_cameras = generate_cameras(reference.mesh.bounds, options.final_views, resolution=options.camera_resolution)
        multiview = multiview_report(reference_index, SurfaceIndex(final_cad, threads=budget.workers), final_cameras)
    report = dict(version='DENSE_NATIVE_CAD_V1', status='improved' if revisions else 'validated_initial',
        mode=options.mode, solver='SciPy bounded trust-region least_squares, soft_l1, grouped parameters and sensitivity probes',
        constraints='Hard parameter bounds and measurement locks; exact native topology, contacts and interference acceptance',
        loss_weights=dict(surface=options.surface_weight, silhouette=options.silhouette_weight,
            normals=options.normal_weight, photo=options.photo_weight, regularization=options.regularization_weight),
        initial=initial, final=final, initial_objective=initial_score, final_objective=best_score,
        units='mm', evaluations=evaluations, stages=stage_reports, revisions=revisions, attempts=attempts,
        stop_reason=stop_reason, multiview=multiview, fitting_views=len(cameras),
        photo_error=best_photo, photo_evidence=photo_evidence,
        photo_verification_status=('reviewed_photo_camera_evidence' if any(v.camera and v.camera.reliable for v in options.photo_views)
            else 'estimated_camera_photo_comparison') if best_photo is not None else 'unverified: usable photo foreground or reviewed evidence required',
        locked_measurements=locked, fixed_dimensions_preserved=True, solid_checks=best_checks,
        processing_seconds=time.monotonic()-started, resources=budget.snapshot(),
        fallback=final_reference.fallback, actual_verification_points=len(final_reference.points),
        additional_neural4d_generations=0, additional_llm_calls=0, physical_accuracy_verified=False,
        fast_model='cached component affine and local control displacement; reverse nearest-point approximation',
        exact_model='rebuilt OCCT B-Rep, topology/contact checks and closest CAD tessellation surface',
        limitations=['Arbitrary sculpted furniture and automatic multi-patch fitting are unresolved',
                    'Final verification is a separate pass and may exceed the numerical solver wall-time budget'])
    if not reference.report.get('winding_consistent', True):
        report['limitations'].append('Reference face winding is inconsistent; normal comparisons need review')
    return DenseOptimizationResult(best_plan, best_build, report, reference, final_reference.points, reverse['distances'])
